name: shaki-ai
description: AI SHAKI — Arman’s branded Telegram AI assistant on Cloudflare Workers, with memory, automation and creative tools.

scripts.test: node --experimental-loader ./tests/ts-resolve.mjs --test tests/core.test.mjs tests/engines.test.mjs tests/regression.test.mjs tests/storage-health.test.mjs tests/tts-reliability.test.mjs tests/provider-routing.test.mjs tests/gemini-key-selection.test.mjs tests/groq-provider.test.mjs tests/gemini-failover.test.mjs tests/key-cooldown-store.test.mjs tests/daily-challenge.test.mjs tests/polls.test.mjs tests/creative-images.test.mjs tests/quote-card.test.mjs tests/roadmap-features.test.mjs tests/shortcuts.test.mjs tests/docx-text.test.mjs tests/group-onboarding.test.mjs tests/telegram-keyboard.test.mjs tests/group-stats.test.mjs tests/group-growth-ui.test.mjs tests/companion-ui.test.mjs tests/owner-identity.test.mjs && node tests/source-regression.mjs && node --experimental-loader ./tests/ts-resolve.mjs --test tests/personalization.test.mjs tests/vip-entitlement.test.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run type-check && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir=.wrangler/dry
scripts.test:repeat: for i in $(seq 1 20); do echo "AI SHAKI test pass $i/20"; npm test || exit 1; done
